label: SCG I.22 underived necessary bearer with distinct stable principles
paraphrase: A finite boundary on bare D → E: in a single actual and necessarily existing one-bearer Ontic model, the existing NoExistingSupportAt holds with empty support while the q.3 profile has esseOf ≠ essenceOf. Its e is permanently conjoined to q, q is marked genuine quiddity, the three interpretive premises of the first n.4 case hold, and the existing ActualUnderivedEssenceIdentity is false. The bare non-entailment is already witnessed by the existing UnderivedEssenceEsse controls; this adds only its compatibility with the first-case bundle. The empty support relation does not mention the conjunction and does not represent an uncaused union. n.4's second case, n.2 and n.6 remain to be answered; this is not a metaphysically possible distinct-but-underived divine being.
